dishes.name: Lake Constance whitefish
dishes.desc: The lake's signature fish, served pan-fried Müllerin style, blue-poached or smoked, with boiled potatoes.

dishes.name: Kretzer fillets
dishes.desc: Small perch fillets from the lake, fried in butter and served with potatoes and salad. Found on Konstanz menus year round.

dishes.name: Pike dumplings
dishes.desc: Light dumplings of pike mousse poached and served in a creamy sauce. A traditional lake-side fish dish.

dishes.name: Schupfnudeln
dishes.desc: Finger-shaped potato noodles fried in butter, often with sauerkraut or bacon. A common dish on Konstanz inn menus.
